status_quo: [STATED] BrewForm currently runs locally with Docker (PostgreSQL, Mailpit) and cannot deploy to Deno Deploy. [INFERRED] Blockers identified from codebase scan: (1) apps/api/src/utils/notify/index.ts uses node:fs, node:path, and mjml at runtime — Deno Deploy isolates cannot access filesystem or arbitrary npm packages with Node-native deps; (2) utils/jobs/index.ts uses setInterval which does not run on Deno Deploy serverless isolates; (3) uploads write to local disk (./uploads) which is ephemeral on Deno Deploy; (4) no S3-compatible storage abstraction; (5) main.ts binds explicit port and registers SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers unconditionally; (6) frontend lacks Deno Deploy static site config; (7) CI workflow uses npm install/npx instead of deno-native commands; (8) packages/db/generated/prisma/ edge client does not exist yet.
ambition: [STATED] 1-star: App deploys to Deno Deploy but cron jobs don't run, uploads are lost on cold starts, emails fail due to missing mjml/node:fs, and CI is manual. 10-star: Fully automated CI/CD with deno-native commands, identical local/dev/prod behavior via driver abstractions (STORAGE_DRIVER=local vs s3, CACHE_DRIVER=memory vs deno-kv), all emails use pre-compiled templates, Deno.cron handles scheduled jobs, frontend deploys as static site with SPA routing, zero-downtime deploys via GitHub integration.
reversibility: [STATED] No irreversible decisions. [INFERRED] All changes are additive and configurable: STORAGE_DRIVER defaults to local (preserves existing behavior), Prisma dual-mode conditionally loads edge client only when DENO_DEPLOY env is set, signal handlers are gated behind !DENO_DEPLOY, Deno.cron is additive (replaces setInterval but local dev still works). Can roll back by reverting git or toggling env vars.
user_impact: [STATED] No breaking changes for existing users. [INFERRED] API contracts remain identical. Frontend URL structure unchanged. Local dev workflow is exactly the same: docker compose up -d && deno task dev. The only visible change for local developers is the addition of Garage S3 service (optional) and new env vars with sensible defaults.
verification: [STATED] Run deno check, deno test, local e2e smoke test. [INFERRED] Specific verification plan: (1) deno check --unstable-sloppy-imports apps/api/src/main.ts must pass; (2) deno test apps/api/src/ packages/shared/src/ must pass; (3) local e2e: register user, create recipe, upload photo (verify in ./uploads), check Mailpit for welcome email, verify cron job registration logs; (4) test S3 driver: set STORAGE_DRIVER=s3 with Garage credentials, upload photo, verify via awscli; (5) build frontend: cd apps/web && deno task build, verify dist/ exists; (6) generate Prisma edge client: deno task db:generate, verify packages/db/generated/prisma/client.ts exists. Documentation: update CLAUDE.md if env/config patterns change.
scope_boundary: [STATED] Code changes to make BrewForm deployable to Deno Deploy while preserving local dev. [INFERRED] OUT OF SCOPE: Deno Deploy dashboard project creation, DNS configuration, domain verification, production database provisioning, production data seeding, monitoring setup — these are covered in deployment_plan.md. IN SCOPE: Prisma dual-mode, email template runtime refactor, S3 storage abstraction, Deno.cron jobs, conditional signal handling, API entry point refactor, frontend static config, env vars, compose.yml Garage service, CI workflow update, dependency cleanup.
